'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russo-Ukrainian War]]
**[[2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[Battle of Kharkiv (2022)|Battle of Kharkiv]]
****[[Ukraine]] says that its [[Ukrainian Ground Forces|troops]] have pushed back [[Russian Armed Forces|Russian forces]] in a [[counter-offensive]], reaching [[Russia–Ukraine border|the border]] with Russia. [[Governor of Kharkiv Oblast|Kharkiv governor]] [[Oleh Synyehubov]] confirms that Ukrainian forces have restored control of a [[border crossing]] with Russia in the region. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/ukrainian-troops-defending-kharkiv-reach-state-border-with-russia-governor-2022-05-16/ (Reuters)]
***[[Siege of Mariupol]]
****Five buses and an [[armored personnel carrier]] evacuate several hundred [[Ukrainian Ground Forces|soldiers]] from the [[Azovstal iron and steel works|Azovstal steel works]] following negotiations with the [[Russian Armed Forces]]. The evacuated soldiers will be exchanged for Russian [[prisoners of war]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/live/world-europe-61461805 (BBC News)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/ukrainian-troops-evacuate-mariupol-ceding-control-russia-2022-05-17/ (Reuters)]
***The [[Russian Defence Ministry]] says that its forces have shot down three [[Ukrainian Air Force]] warplanes, including a [[Sukhoi Su-25|Su-25]] over [[Mykolaiv]] and a [[Sukhoi Su-24|Su-24]] strike jet near [[Snake Island (Ukraine)|Snake Island]] in the [[Black Sea]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russia-says-it-shot-down-three-ukrainian-fighter-jets-one-near-snake-island-2022-05-16/ (Reuters)]
*[[Somali Civil War (2009–present)|Somali Civil War]]
**[[American military intervention in Somalia (2007–present)|American military intervention in Somalia]]
***[[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Joe Biden]] announces that American troops will be redeployed to [[Somalia]], reversing a previous order under former President [[Donald Trump]]. [https://abcnews.go.com/amp/Politics/biden-approves-return-us-troops-somalia-counterterrorism-fight/story?id=84752064 (ABC News)]
 
'''Business and economy'''
*[[Boycott of Russia and Belarus]]
**[[McDonald's]] announces that it has begun the process of selling all of its restaurants in [[Russia]] citing the "humanitarian crisis caused by the [[2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine|war in Ukraine]]", as the reason for ending operations in the country after 32 years. It is later announced that these restaurants will reopen under a new brand in mid-June, and that their menus will be retained. [https://www.reuters.com/business/mcdonalds-exit-russia-after-30-years-2022-05-16/ (Reuters)] [https://tass.com/economy/1451435/amp (TASS)] 
*The [[Russian ruble]] approaches a 5-year high against the [[Euro]] to become "the world's best-performing currency [[wiktionary:year to date|so far this year]]" as foreign currency supply exceeds demand. [https://www.reuters.com/markets/europe/russian-rouble-hovers-near-5-year-highs-vs-euro-stocks-up-2022-05-16/ (Reuters)]
*Commercial flights from [[Sanaa International Airport]] in [[Sanaa]], [[Yemen]], resume after six years. The [[Yemenia]] flight carried 151 passengers to the [[Jordan]]ian capital [[Amman]]. [https://www.france24.com/en/middle-east/20220516-first-commercial-flight-in-years-takes-off-from-yemen-s-sanaa-amid-fragile-truce (France 24)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[Wildfires in 2022]]
**[[2022 New Mexico wildfires]]
***The [[Calf Canyon/Hermits Peak Fire]] in [[New Mexico]], U.S, grows to 300,000 acres, becoming the largest wildfire in the state's history. [https://www.cnn.com/2022/05/16/weather/new-mexico-fires-monday/index.html (CNN)]
*Fourteen people are killed and 19 others are injured after a tourist bus crashes into a [[billboard]] in [[Mojokerto]], [[East Java]], [[Indonesia]]. [https://apnews.com/article/indonesia-accidents-java-471048d5760e364afe629e0a3ed83f92 (AP)]
*One person is killed and 85 others are injured after a [[cargo train]] collides with a [[passenger train]] in [[Catalonia]], [[Spain]]. [https://apnews.com/article/barcelona-spain-accidents-f89a74590687f2eb15e89d6fdd08c9c5 (AP)]

'''Law and crime'''
*The [[Ghana]]ian [[Ministry of Defence (Ghana)|Ministry of Defence]] warns that the possibility of a [[terrorist attack]] occurring in the country is "very real" and that the country's defence system has been placed on high alert. [https://yen.com.gh/ghana/207215-terrorist-attack-ghana-government-official-raises-alarm-because-threat-is-real/ (Yen.com.gh)] [https://www.ghanaweb.com/GhanaHomePage/NewsArchive/Ghana-warned-to-be-vigilant-as-8-soldiers-die-in-terrorist-attack-in-Togo-1538624 (GhanaWeb)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[Enlargement of NATO]]
**[[Sweden–NATO relations]]
***[[Prime Minister of Sweden|Prime Minister]] [[Magdalena Andersson]] confirms the decision her [[Swedish Social Democratic Party|party]] made on Sunday and formally announces [[Sweden]]'s intent to join [[NATO]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2022/may/16/russia-finland-sweden-nato-ukraine-war (''The Guardian'')]
***In response, [[President of Russia|Russian President]] [[Vladimir Putin]] warns that Russia will react to the "expansion of military infrastructure" by NATO in Sweden and [[Finland]], saying that "problems are being created for no reason at all. We shall react accordingly". [https://news.sky.com/story/ukraine-war-putin-warns-russia-will-respond-if-nato-boosts-finland-and-swedens-military-strength-12614582 (Sky News)]
*[[Borne government]]
**[[Minister of Labour, Employment and Economic Inclusion (France)|French Minister of Labour]] [[Élisabeth Borne]] is appointed by [[President of France|President]] [[Emmanuel Macron]] as the new [[Prime Minister of France]], succeeding [[Jean Castex]]. [https://www.lemonde.fr/en/france/article/2022/05/16/elisabeth-borne-appointed-france-s-new-prime-minister_5983735_7.html (''Le Monde'' in English)]
